staggered_1st_uniform_cc_to_face.accuracy: O(h^2) (two-point centered difference at the half-offset face)
staggered_1st_uniform_cc_to_face.reference: Harlow & Welch (1965), Physics of Fluids 8(12):2182-2189 (MAC staggered grid); MethodOfLines.jl #531 StaggeredStencilInfo EdgeAlignedVar offsets [-1,0]: d/dx(u)|_face[j] = (u_cc[j] - u_cc[j-1]) / h.
staggered_1st_uniform_cc_to_face.notes: Cell-center-to-face staggered 1st-order gradient: reads cell-center scalar $u at offsets {-1, 0} relative to face_x output index to compute (u[$x] - u[$x-1]) / h. Mirrors MOL StaggeredStencilInfo EdgeAlignedVar (offsets [-1,0]) from MethodOfLines.jl #531 at pinned SHA 35cc9143dc553ac7d3619738bd77b250c1ed162f. Sibling rule staggered_1st_uniform_face_to_cc handles the face-to-cell-center direction.

staggered_1st_uniform_face_to_cc.accuracy: O(h^2) (two-point centered difference at the half-offset cell center)
staggered_1st_uniform_face_to_cc.reference: Harlow & Welch (1965), Physics of Fluids 8(12):2182-2189 (MAC staggered grid); MethodOfLines.jl #531 StaggeredStencilInfo CenterAlignedVar offsets [0,1]: d/dx(u)|_cc[i] = (u_face[i+1] - u_face[i]) / h.
staggered_1st_uniform_face_to_cc.notes: Face-to-cell-center staggered 1st-order gradient: reads face_x scalar $u at offsets {0, +1} relative to cell_center output index to compute (u[$x+1] - u[$x]) / h. Mirrors MOL StaggeredStencilInfo CenterAlignedVar (offsets [0,1]) from MethodOfLines.jl #531 at pinned SHA 35cc9143dc553ac7d3619738bd77b250c1ed162f. Sibling rule staggered_1st_uniform_cc_to_face handles the cell-center-to-face direction.
